title: Brickfall Breaker Arcade - Post-run QC
verdict: Core delivery ready; strict batch-robustness evidence incomplete

runs.label: Claude Haiku 4.5 attempt 1

runs.label: Claude Haiku 4.5 attempt 2
runs.note: OpenHands reported context_window=0, generated 250 empty condensation pairs, reached max iteration 500, and recorded zero input/output tokens. This is not a Haiku task score.

runs.label: Claude Haiku 4.5 graded zero run
runs.note: The exact completed rollout was regraded after a transient Harbor verifier no-op. Render passed, but the artifact omitted public/game.js, so same-origin delivery and every authenticated workflow genuinely failed. The local Docker regrade changed only verifier networking from allowlist to public; criterion files matched canonical v2.2.1.

haiku_diagnosis.root_cause: The first usable OpenHands attempt lacked OpenRouter Haiku token metadata and entered a zero-context condenser loop. Explicit max-input/max-output metadata fixed model execution. The corrected rollout's initial verifier handoff was an ungraded no-op; regrading the exact artifact showed the genuine task failure was a missing public/game.js, which left handleSignIn undefined.
haiku_diagnosis.prepared_fix: The completed run used model_info max_input_tokens=200000 and max_output_tokens=8192 and drop_params=true.
haiku_diagnosis.reason: The corrected run has non-zero model usage, no trial exception, full criterion evidence, graded=1 and no_op=0. Its reward 0.0 is a valid Haiku task score.
